description: This file contains a migration class for setting up and updating the database schema related to themes, menu items, permissions, and internationalization groups in the OrangeHRM application for version 4.9.0. It includes methods for creating tables, inserting initial data, and modifying database schema elements.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: A migration class for database schema updates specific to version 4.9.0 of OrangeHRM, responsible for creating and altering tables related to themes, menu items, and internationalization groups.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Executes the database schema updates, including creating tables, inserting data, and modifying schema elements.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version string '4.9' indicating the migration version.

methods.name: insertMenuItems
methods.description: Helper method to insert a menu item into the 'ohrm_menu_item' table with specific parameters.

methods.name: insertTheme
methods.description: Helper method to insert a new theme into the 'ohrm_theme' table if it does not already exist.
